name: Los Angeles
blurb: A city built for starting over. The hard part is not landing - it is who still knows you by month three.
arc: LA spreads people out; nobody meets anyone by accident. The first month feels social, the third feels quiet.
Fen keeps the few real connections warm across the sprawl, so distance never turns into silence.

zh.name: 洛杉矶
zh.blurb: 一座为重新开始而建的城市。难的不是落地，是第三个月还有谁知道你。
arc: 洛杉矶把人摊得很开，没有人会「顺便遇见」谁。第一个月热热闹闹，第三个月安静得能听见回声。
你的分身替你守住那几个真聊得来的人——城市再大，不该把联系冲散。

name: Tokyo
blurb: Polite, dense, and famously hard to enter. Circles here open slowly - and close slowly too.
arc: Tokyo rewards patience: groups form over months, not mixers. Pushing faster only gets you politeness.
Fen plays the long game for you - keeping every thread alive until there is a real reason to be invited in.

zh.name: 东京
zh.blurb: 礼貌、密集、出了名地难进入。这里的圈子开得慢，关得也慢。
arc: 东京奖励耐心：圈子按月成形，不按局。推得越急，得到的只有礼貌。
你的分身替你下慢棋——记住每一条线，等到真正被邀请入场的那个时机。

name: Ho Chi Minh City
blurb: Fast, young, and still forming. The people who arrive now set the tone for years.
arc: Saigon moves fast: new cafes, new crews, new everythings. Early arrivals do not just find circles - they become them.
Fen maps the moving city for you, so the people worth keeping never slip past in the rush.

zh.name: 胡志明市
zh.blurb: 快、年轻、还在成形。现在来的人，定未来几年的调。
arc: 西贡跑得飞快：新咖啡馆、新局、新的一切。先来的人不只是找到圈子——他们自己就是圈子。
你的分身替你记下这座流动的城市，让值得留住的人不在奔忙中滑走。

name: Singapore
blurb: Small, efficient, and quietly gated. Everyone is transient, which makes continuity rare.
arc: Singapore is easy to land in and hard to root in: visas rotate, friends rotate, plans rotate.
Fen is the fixed point - it keeps your people across every rotation, so each new arrival starts warmer.

zh.name: 新加坡
zh.blurb: 小而高效，却安静地设着门槛。人人都是过客，连续因此稀缺。
arc: 新加坡落地容易扎根难：准证在轮换，朋友在轮换，计划也在轮换。
你的分身是那个定点——替你把人留住，让每一次重新落地都比上次更暖。

name: Hong Kong
blurb: Vertical, fast, and dense with people in motion. Everyone is one stop away, and somehow never meets.
arc: Eight million lives stacked into a few square kilometres: everyone is one MTR stop away, and no one ever bumps into anyone.
Fen goes first - it sets the table, keeps the threads warm, and tells you when it is your turn to show up.

zh.name: 香港
zh.blurb: 垂直、飞快、密不透风。每个人都近在一站地铁，却总是遇不上。
arc: 八百万人叠在几平方公里里，谁都只隔一站地铁，却谁也碰不上谁。
你的分身先走一步：把局攒好，把线焐热，然后告诉你——该你出场了。

name: Sydney
blurb: Warm, outdoorsy, and built around long-established crews. Newcomers are welcomed - and rarely absorbed.
arc: Sydney is friendly on the surface, but most circles date back to school or surf club. Being liked is easy; being included takes time.
Fen stays in the room for you, keeping each thread warm until the invitation is real.

zh.name: 悉尼
zh.blurb: 友好、户外、围着老圈子转。新人总受欢迎——却很少被真正吸纳。
arc: 悉尼表面热络，但多数圈子从学生时代延续到今天。被喜欢容易，被接纳需要时间。
你的分身替你守在场内，把每条线焐热，直到邀请成真。
